top_signals.title: Treasury Wine Flags $395 Million Writedown Over Excess US Supply
top_signals.summary: Australia vintner Treasury Wine Estates Ltd. has flagged a A$558.4 million ($395 million) post-tax writedown ahead of its full year earnings on Thursday, as part of a broader effort to tackle supply chain problems in its US market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Jetstar, Qatar Air Near Miss at Sydney Triggers Safety Probe
top_signals.summary: An air safety investigation is underway after a Jetstar plane and a Qatar Airways jet almost collided on the tarmac at Sydney airport on Sunday — the second near miss in two weeks.

top_signals.title: Yemen’s Houthis attack Saudi refinery after kingdom signs defense pact
top_signals.summary: The alliance with Sunni Muslim U.S. allies, Turkey and Pakistan, stipulates that an attack against one would ​be regarded as an attack on all.

top_signals.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
top_signals.summary: A 26-year-old Canadian man once described as one of the most consequential cybercrime threat actors of 2024 has pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy to hack and extort more than 165 organizations that used the cloud data storage provider Snowflake. Connor Riley Moucka, of Kitchener, Ontario, also admitted to stealing call and text history records of more than 100 million AT&T customers.
